display.purpose: Landing hero name only — Italiana hairline caps with the gold halo text-shadow.

headline.purpose: Archive page titles (.obs-title): The Meridian, chart names. Landing section titles are the smaller clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.6rem) variant.

title.purpose: Station names on the meridian; hover shifts color to Heated Gold.

body.purpose: Long-form reading copy (the bio), uppercase mono in Reading Cream, max 64ch.

label.purpose: All microcopy — nav, data rows, counters, captions, legal. Uppercase Fragment Mono; tracking .13–.5em is the hierarchy.

shadows.name: plate-bloom
shadows.purpose: Ambient light a landing plate spills into the void; fades in 2.6s after ignition on an inset ::after.

shadows.name: station-bloom
shadows.purpose: Meridian station plate bloom, 2.2s ease with .25s delay on entry.

shadows.name: lightbox-frame-glow
shadows.purpose: The held plate's own light in the lightbox, on a pseudo inset 8% 6%.

shadows.name: title-halo
shadows.purpose: Gold halo on display/headline type (archive titles use .18/.08).

shadows.name: ink-glow
shadows.purpose: The meridian ink's glow as it draws.

shadows.name: tick-glow
shadows.purpose: Station survey tick when its station is hovered (tick also fills gold).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The world's only named easing; all entrances, travel, and hover recoveries.

motion.name: ignition
motion.value: opacity 0 → 1, scale(.96–.975) → 1, brightness(.22–.25) saturate(.7–.72) → none, over 1.1–1.3s ease-out
motion.purpose: Ember-to-lit entrance for plates, stations, and frames via IntersectionObserver (threshold .08–.12, rootMargin -6% bottom); JS staggers 45ms × (n mod 10), atlas cards 110ms capped at 440ms.

motion.name: meridian-ink
motion.value: transform: scaleY(0→1), origin top; progress = clamp((vh·0.72 − rect.top) / height)
motion.purpose: The survey line draws with the descent; rAF-throttled scroll/resize, transform-only. Reduced motion pins scaleY(1).

motion.name: lightbox-travel
motion.value: classes .is-on / .from-next (+34px, .99) / .from-prev (−34px) / .to-next (−26px, fade) / .to-prev (+26px); SWAP_MS 560; commit via forced reflow (void offsetWidth), not rAF
motion.purpose: Direction-aware two-layer crossfade between frames; reduced motion swaps instantly.

motion.name: hero-choreography
motion.value: name resolves (blur 20px + brightness 1.9 → clear, 1.7s @ .5s); rises at 1.5/1.75/1.95/2.55s; topbar 2.3s; hero plates ignite 1500/2050/2550ms
motion.purpose: Landing load sequence — the name resolves out of darkness before the instruments light.

motion.name: parallax-drift
motion.value: translate3d only, data-speed per tile, clamp ±60px, rAF-throttled; desktop fine-pointer, no-reduce only
motion.purpose: Plates float at depth on the landing.

motion.name: ambient
motion.value: starfield twinkle 9s ease-in-out alternate (opacity .18–.48); orbit spin 150s linear; plumb line 3s scaleY sweep
motion.purpose: The sky breathes; slow enough to never compete with the photographs.

motion.name: reduced-motion-collapse
motion.value: .01ms durations, ignition states forced visible, parallax/ink unbound in JS, lightbox instant swap
motion.purpose: The static promise — CSS and JS branches both collapse.

narrative.northStar: The photographs are the only light.
narrative.overview:
The public site is an astronomer's private observatory after dark. The page is a #050505 void under a fixed, sparse starfield; the photographs hang in it as celestial bodies — dimmed at rest, ignited on approach — and every piece of interface is an instrument marking drawn around them in monogram gold. Type speaks in two voices only: Italiana, a hairline high-contrast serif, for designations (names, titles, chart headings), and Fragment Mono, uppercase and widely tracked, for the log lines that annotate them. The register is a survey log-book: photographs are observations and plates, collections are charts on The Meridian, dates are epochs, the about section is Field Notes, the footer signs off with coordinates.

Two page families share the world. The landing descends from the hero name through numbered plates into The Atlas. The archive is The Meridian — every collection as a station on one gold survey line that draws itself as the visitor descends, newest epoch first, ending at First light — and each chart page is a masonry field of frames opened by the lightbox viewing instrument. The form refuses the category-default same-size card grid everywhere: plates meander, stations alternate across the line, atlas cards follow an editorial 12-column cycle.

Motion is a single grammar: things ignite. Frames arrive as embers (dark, slightly small, desaturated) and warm to full luminance; the meridian ink draws with scroll; lightbox frames travel directionally and bloom on arrival. All scroll- and entrance-driven motion writes only transform, opacity, and filter, and the whole system collapses to visible-and-static under prefers-reduced-motion — in CSS and in every JS branch.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black ground; warm star-white text; gold reserved for instrumentation.
Photographs are the brightest objects on screen — the UI never outshines them.
Two typefaces, one weight (400); microcopy is uppercase tracked mono.
Sharp corners everywhere; light blooms, nothing casts a drop shadow.
Ignition motion grammar; transform/opacity/filter only; reduced-motion safe.
Log-book voice; epoch-only captions; Roman numerals for charts, zero-padded Arabic for frames.
No contact information anywhere on the public surface.

rules.name: The Only-Light Rule
rules.body: The photographs are the brightest things in the room. Images rest slightly dimmed (filter: brightness(.88–.9); hero-orbit plates at opacity .88) and reach or exceed full luminance (brightness 1.02–1.07) only on ignition, hover, or in the lightbox. No UI element may glow brighter than a lit plate; the starfield stays at opacity ≤ .44.

rules.name: The Instrument-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks instrumentation and data — lines, ticks, counters, labels, numerals, focus — and is never the color of a paragraph. Inside a dim log line, only the data values go gold (240 frames).

rules.name: The Log-Line Rule
rules.body: All microcopy is Fragment Mono, weight 400, uppercase, tracked ≥ .13em, at .56–.74rem. If a piece of text is not a designation (Italiana) it is a log line — there is no third voice.

rules.name: The Recenter Rule
rules.body: Centered tracked-caps labels carry text-indent equal to their letter-spacing (cue .5em, section numerals .35em, seal .22em, terminus .4em) so the tracking's trailing space doesn't push them off optical center.

rules.name: The Tabular-Instrument Rule
rules.body: Counters are zero-padded with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums ("Plate 01", "042 / 119"); charts and sections are numbered in Roman numerals ("Chart II", section "I · The Plates").

rules.name: The Sky-Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Vertical space between observations is proportional to the viewport (vh-based clamps), never a fixed pixel scale — the descent must feel like distance traveled.

rules.name: The Bloom-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow may only render light the element emits: zero-offset, gold or cream, generously blurred. A dark or offset drop shadow is a foreign object in this world.

rules.name: The Drawn-Icon Rule
rules.body: Icons are one-stroke inline SVG paths — fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width 1–1.4 — built in markup or by app.js's icon() helper. Never font glyphs, never emoji, never icon fonts.

dos: Do set every public page on the void (#050505) with the fixed starfield behind content at z-index 0 — one sky, no second background color.
Do let images rest dimmed (brightness .88–.9) and reach full light only through ignition, hover, or the lightbox (The Only-Light Rule).
Do write all microcopy as Fragment Mono 400 uppercase, .56–.74rem, tracked ≥ .13em, and put data values in gold spans inside dim lines.
Do animate entrances as ignition: opacity + scale(.96–.975) + brightness(.22–.25)/saturate(.7) → lit, over ~1.1–1.3s --ease-out, driven by IntersectionObserver, with blooms fading in after.
Do draw every icon as a one-stroke SVG (stroke-width 1–1.4, currentColor, no fill) and every counter zero-padded tabular; number charts and sections in Roman numerals.
Do provide the static promise: reduced-motion must neutralize both the CSS (durations, forced-visible states) and the JS branch (no parallax, no ink, instant lightbox swap).
Do preserve string.Template $var placeholders and server-owned component markup (.tile, .collection-card, .station, .ph) — restyle them, never restructure them in CSS-only changes.
Do caption photographs with their epoch only ("2016 · Mar 4" / "2008 — 2016").
donts: Don't use backdrop-filter or background-attachment anywhere, or animate layout properties — scroll/entrance motion touches only transform/opacity/filter.
Don't cast dark or offset drop shadows, round a corner, or border a photograph — shadows are zero-offset light blooms only.
Don't show filenames, titles, EXIF, or any metadata beyond the epoch; don't add contact information (email, phone, social) anywhere public.
Don't introduce a third typeface, a second font weight, pure #FFFFFF text, or gold body paragraphs.
Don't use font glyphs, emoji, or icon fonts for iconography.
Don't apply the cream :root system (Anton, paper, ink) to any public surface, or Observatory styling to body.admin — the boundary is the body.inner scope.
Don't default to a uniform same-size card grid; new fields follow the world's asymmetric grammars (meander, meridian, editorial cycle, masonry).
